title: Tiemann Mounted Urodynamic Catheter Technique for Difficult Bladder Catheterization
brief_summary: A report of a technique for insertion a soft urodynamic catheter into the bladder, when urethral obstruction causes the catheter to bend and fold over itself at the resistance site.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- MEN THAT UNDERWENT URODYNAMIC STUDY EVALUATION BETWEEN 6/2011 TO 9/2013

Exclusion Criteria:

NONE

\-
study_population: MALE PATIENTS 18-80 Y/O WHO UNDERWENT URODYNAMIC STUDY, AND HAD DIFFICULT CATHETERIZATION
